title: Oracle says OpenAI contract is fully funded, addresses market financing scrutiny
summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) stated that it has secured the capital needed to fulfill its cloud infrastructure contract with OpenAI, describing itself as the first hyperscaler fully funded for the current artificial intelligence investment cycle. According to the company, a final capital raise earlier this month completed the financing framework previously outlined at its investor day, including vendor financing arrangements.
